name: Copper Canyons
description: Six camps in a banded rock desert. Three races cross at the middle and cut the ground into six wedges, so every neighbour is two crossings away: one under the junction knaps, one out at the rim stacks. A mesa lies across each wedge, and the lane past it is where the sector is won.
theme: Copper dust, flash rain, and six armies in the same canyon system.
